entries.title: Psalms 102:1
segments: ¶<<A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before Jehovah.>> Jehovah, hear my prayer, and let my cry come unto thee.

entries.title: Psalms 102:2
segments: Hide not thy face from me: in the day of my trouble, incline thine ear unto me; in the day I call, answer me speedily.

entries.title: Psalms 102:3
segments: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as a firebrand.

entries.title: Psalms 102:4
segments: My heart is smitten and withered like grass; yea, I have forgotten to eat my bread.

entries.title: Psalms 102:5
segments: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones cleave to my flesh.

entries.title: Psalms 102:6
segments: I am become like the pelican of the wilderness, I am as an owl in desolate places;

entries.title: Psalms 102:7
segments: I watch, and am like a sparrow alone upon the housetop.

entries.title: Psalms 102:8
segments: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; they that are mad against me swear by me.

entries.title: Psalms 102:9
segments: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,

entries.title: Psalms 102:10
segments: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath; for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.

entries.title: Psalms 102:11
segments: My days are like a lengthened-out shadow, and I, I am withered like grass.

entries.title: Psalms 102:12
segments: ¶But thou, Jehovah, abidest for ever, and thy memorial from generation to generation.

entries.title: Psalms 102:13
segments: *Thou* wilt rise up, thou wilt have mercy upon Zion: for it is the time to be gracious to her, for the set time is come.

entries.title: Psalms 102:14
segments: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour her dust.

entries.title: Psalms 102:15
segments: And the nations shall fear the name of Jehovah, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.

entries.title: Psalms 102:16
segments: When Jehovah shall build up Zion, he will appear in his glory.

entries.title: Psalms 102:17
segments: He will regard the prayer of the destitute one, and not despise their prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 102:18
segments: This shall be written for the generation to come; and a people that shall be created shall praise Jah:

entries.title: Psalms 102:19
segments: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from the heavens hath Jehovah beheld the earth,

entries.title: Psalms 102:20
segments: To hear the groaning of the prisoner, to loose those that are appointed to die;

entries.title: Psalms 102:21
segments: That the name of Jehovah may be declared in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,

entries.title: Psalms 102:22
segments: When the peoples shall be gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 102:23
segments: ¶He weakened my strength in the way, he shortened my days.

entries.title: Psalms 102:24
segments: I said, My *God, take me not away in the midst of my days! ...Thy years are from generation to generation.

entries.title: Psalms 102:25
segments: Of old hast thou founded the earth, and the heavens are the work of thy hands:

entries.title: Psalms 102:26
segments: *They* shall perish, but *thou* continuest; and all of them shall grow old as a garment: as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed.

entries.title: Psalms 102:27
segments: But thou art the Same, and thy years shall have no end.

entries.title: Psalms 102:28
segments: The children of thy servants shall abide, and their seed shall be established before thee.
